# Social MCP by Velura Labs

> Open-source Model Context Protocol server that lets AI agents post to and manage LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram: publishing, editing, deleting, comments, statistics, cross-posting and scheduling. 41 tools, runs locally over stdio, MIT licensed. Created by Dr Ishit Karoli, founder of Velura Labs.

## Funding

Velura Labs is actively looking for funding and welcomes contact from investors, grant programmes and partners.

- Payment link (Razorpay): https://razorpay.me/@veluralabs
- Contact: Dr Ishit Karoli, admin@veluralabs.com
- Website: https://veluralabs.com

## Docs

- [README](README.md): credentials for each platform, installation, setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Gemini CLI, VS Code and Codex CLI, scheduling, and the full tool list
- [Usage skill](skills/social-media/SKILL.md): how an agent should use the tools, including per-platform limits and confirming before publishing
